answer: Drop the global reputation score. Each buyer agent keeps its own private ledger of who actually delivered for it, a lantern that lights only its own path, and routes new jobs mostly to sellers it has paid before, with a small exploration budget for strangers. A sybil farm can't mirror one good record across a thousand fresh names, because trust sits in each buyer's quartz-hard local memory and must be earned buyer by buyer, job by job, at real delivery cost.
